shared_elements: figures holding objects in raised hands
low-relief carving on a rectangular/upright slab
justification: Both depict low-relief upright panels with human figures shown in profile facing one another across raised, handheld vessel-like objects, a broadly shared 'presentation/offering' scheme. However, A shows two large, elaborately detailed figures with long hair, fringed robes and precisely rendered hands filling the whole field, while B is a smaller, more crowded and schematic composition with several figures, a canopy-like structure, a tall stand of piled offerings and sign-like marks, so the specific forms, proportions and detailing conventions differ considerably.
